provenance: Codex subagent review of immutable prepared inputs; findings checked against source, separate from deterministic validation.
rationale: Unique/Syntax ClassName and FieldName are String categories and Class has an ordered List FieldName; the prose declaration packages the class name with those fields. Distinct declared names/fields are the well-formedness convention, not extra fields in Class. Empty lists support empty classes. The opening ownership-transfer intent is supported by the retained Unique/Step context: Eval.give uses Take to replace the occupied source with none, and Eval.new evaluates arguments sequentially and allocate puts their results into occupied fields.
limitations: This compares the opening model intent and declaration grammar with formal definitions; it does not audit proof tactics or attest to a compiler run.
